law.catch_line: Question to be printed on ballots
law.text: The question to be printed on the ballots used in any referendum held pursuant to this chapter shall be as follows: "Do you favor additional market development, education, publicity, research, and the promotion of the sale and use of small grains and continuation of the levy of an assessment of one-half of one percent of the selling price per bushel in accordance with the provisions of the Small Grains Board law? _____ Yes _____ No."
